# 1h Agent hand-off: contract

**Read first:** [template authoring → Handing the draft to an agent](../processes/servers/template-authoring.md#steps--handing-the-draft-to-an-agent), [events → Servers](../events.md#servers) (`template.agent_session_*`), design `RP-Template-agent`, the 1a/1b **As built** (draft revisions, the editor's "draft changed" band), the 0b CSRF and public-route rules.

**Done when:** the admin opens **Hand off to an agent…** from the editor or the template page, gets a one-time prompt with a scoped token, an agent can read context, read and write draft files with ETags, validate and preview through `/agent/v1`, the editor and template page show the session band with **What it changed** and **Revoke access**, sessions end on expiry, revoke, publish, discard, replacement or the 8-hour cap; every checklist line has its test.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Token | `pxa_` + `vault.NewToken()` (43 chars). Stored only as `vault.Lookup(token)` in `token_lookup`. Shown once, inside the prompt. | template-authoring.md; CLAUDE.md "never stored in plain text". |
| Auth | `Authorization: Bearer pxa_…` only. `/agent/v1/*` is a **public route** for the cookie rules (never reads or sets a cookie, no CSRF), with its own middleware: lookup → session open and not expired → template matches → rate limit. Every failure is `401 {"error":"session ended"}` (ended, expired, unknown token alike) or `429`. | 0b public-route rule. |
| Expiry | 30 min, 2 h (default), 8 h; `expires_at = opened_at + d`, never beyond 8 h. Expiry is enforced on each request; a schedule `servers.agent_sessions` every 5 min closes expired sessions with `expired` and records `template.agent_session_closed{reason, saves}`. | |
| One per draft | Opening a session closes the open one with `replaced` (a new reason) in the same `Write`. The partial unique index enforces it. | Rule "one open session per draft". |
| Ends with the draft | Publish closes with `published`, Discard with `discarded`, in their transactions. | |
| Rate limit | `requests` total ≤ 600 per session; ≤ 60 per minute (`minute_start`/`minute_count`, a fixed window). Counted in the same write as the request's effect, or a tiny write for reads. Over → `429` with `Retry-After`. | |
| Counter writes | Every request, reads included, writes the counters (one short `Write`). Acceptable: agent traffic is small and the write is one row. | Simplicity over a memory counter that a restart would reset. |
| ETag | `ETag` of a file = `"<revision>-<sha256(content)[:16]>"`; of the draft = `"<revision>"`. `PUT`/`DELETE` require `If-Match` with the file's ETag (or `*` only for creating a new file: `If-None-Match: *`). A mismatch → `412 {"error":"the draft changed"}`. A successful write bumps the revision (`SaveDraft` with `by: agent`, actor `agent:<session id>`). | template-authoring.md. |
| Actor | `agent:<session id>` (a new actor kind). Activity's **What it changed** = events with that actor. | events.md "by the agent". |
| Context | Chosen at opening and fixed: latest validation report (computed then), a failed job's log (only jobs of servers built from this template; the stored log is already redacted), a preview for chosen **active** servers (rendered on request, secrets `•••`), the diff against the base version (computed on request). `GET /context` returns the problem text, template name, slug, base version, these items, and links (`/draft`, `/docs/manifest`). | |
| Preview servers | `POST /draft/preview?server=<name>` only for servers chosen at opening; others → `403`. Generated values and secret parameters render as `•••`; the response never contains a real secret. | Narrow scope. |
| Docs | `GET /docs/manifest`: Markdown generated from the same source as the validator rules (the manifest reference of modules/servers.md, embedded at build time from `docs/modules/servers.md#manifest` through `go:embed` of a copy kept in `servers/agent/manifest.md`, checked equal by a test). | One source of truth. |
| Prompt | Markdown built from a template per agent (`claude-code`, `codex`, `other` differ only in the opening line): the problem, the base URL (`PROXIER_BASE_URL` + `/agent/v1`), the token, the API table, the rules (no publish, ETags, secrets are masked, finish by saying what changed). The dialog shows it with the token masked and **Copy prompt** copies the real one (the page holds it only in that response; a reload shows "already copied — open a new hand-off"). No download. | template-authoring.md. |
| Editor coexistence | The admin's open editor polls `GET /templates/:id/draft/revision` every 10 s while a session is open (htmx); a newer revision shows 1b's "draft changed" band with **Reload**. | |
| Band | On the template page and the editor: opened by, the problem's first line, saves, validations, expires in, **What it changed** (`/activity?actor=agent:<id>`), **Revoke access** (strength 1 → `revoked`). | |
| Events | `template.agent_session_opened{expires_at, context}` (**on**, 🤖), `template.draft_saved{by: agent}`, `template.draft_validated{by: agent}`, `template.agent_session_closed{reason, saves}`. | events.md. |
| Size limits | The editor's: 1 MiB per file, 10 MiB per draft; request bodies over 1 MiB → `413`. Paths per 1a's rules. | |

## Files

```
internal/modules/servers/agent/{agent.go,api.go,prompt.go,manifest.md}_test
internal/modules/servers/pages/{agent.go,agent.templ}, agent_test.go
internal/platform/events/…            "agent:<id>" accepted as an actor
```

## Go signatures

```go
package agent

type Open struct {
	TemplateID     int64
	Problem        string
	Agent          string // claude-code codex other
	For            time.Duration
	IncludeReport  bool
	JobID          int64   // 0 = none
	ServerIDs      []int64 // previews allowed
	IncludeDiff    bool
}
type Opened struct {
	SessionID int64
	Token     string // shown once
	Prompt    string
	ExpiresAt time.Time
}
func (s *Service) OpenSession(ctx context.Context, o Open, actor string) (Opened, error)
func (s *Service) Revoke(ctx context.Context, sessionID int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) CloseForDraft(ctx context.Context, tx *sqlx.Tx, templateID int64, reason string) error // publish, discard
func (s *Service) Routes(g *echo.Group) // /agent/v1
func (s *Service) Schedule() jobs.Schedule
```

`templates.Service.Publish` and `DiscardDraft` call `CloseForDraft` in their transactions (an interface hook set in `Init`, so `templates` doesn't import `agent`).

## Routes

Admin: `GET /templates/:id/agent` (dialog), `POST /templates/:id/agent` (open → prompt view), `POST /templates/:id/agent/:sid/revoke`, `GET /templates/:id/draft/revision`.

Agent API (`/agent/v1`): exactly the table in template-authoring.md.

- `CONTEXT.md` (untracked): the actor `agent:<id>` if the glossary lists actors.

## Checklist

In `agent/agent_test.go` and `agent/api_test.go`:

- [ ] Opening returns a `pxa_` token stored only as a lookup; `template.agent_session_opened` notifies — `TestOpenSession`
- [ ] A second hand-off closes the first with `replaced`; the old token gets 401 — `TestOneSessionPerDraft`
- [ ] Expiry → 401 "session ended"; the schedule records `agent_session_closed{expired}` — `TestSessionExpires`
- [ ] Revoke → 401; `revoked` — `TestRevoke`
- [ ] Publish and discard close the session — `TestDraftEndClosesSession`
- [ ] More than 8 h asked → capped at 8 h — `TestEightHourCap`
- [ ] PUT with a stale `If-Match` → 412; with the right one → saved, revision bumped, `draft_saved{by: agent}` with actor `agent:<id>` — `TestAgentWriteNeedsETag`
- [ ] DELETE with `If-Match` deletes; creating needs `If-None-Match: *` — `TestAgentCreateAndDelete`
- [ ] The token can't publish, discard, import, deploy, or reach another template's draft (every such path → 401/404, nothing changes) — `TestAgentScopeIsNarrow`
- [ ] Preview for a server not chosen → 403; a chosen one renders with secrets as `•••` (the response contains no generated value) — `TestAgentPreviewIsMasked`
- [ ] The job log in the context is the redacted one — `TestAgentContextLogIsRedacted`
- [ ] 61st request in a minute → 429; 601st in the session → 429 — `TestAgentRateLimits`
- [ ] A session cookie on `/agent/v1` is ignored; no cookie is ever set — `TestAgentAPIIgnoresCookies`
- [ ] Files over 1 MiB → 413 — `TestAgentSizeLimit`
- [ ] `manifest.md` equals the manifest section of modules/servers.md — `TestManifestDocsInSync`

In `pages/agent_test.go`:

- [ ] Dialog shows the prompt with the token masked; Copy gives the real one; a reload doesn't show it again — `TestHandOffDialog`
- [ ] The band shows saves and expiry; **What it changed** filters Activity by the agent actor — `TestSessionBand`
- [ ] The editor shows "draft changed" after an agent save — `TestEditorSeesAgentSave`
